parsed.why: Protective division: shield law, 1993 non-discrimination, hate-crime cover, open markers, no sodomy law. But national passport/entry regime applies, and documented 2012 birth-sex prison placement with assault tempers the top tier.

Most-Protective tier: shield law, identity-congruent custody policy (2018), open documents with X, hate-crime cover, discrimination ban. National document and entry regime still binds; no division-specific exposure documented.

Hostile division: birth-certificate-based facility law in all schools/colleges, M/F-only licence rule, forced-outing statute, no state discrimination statute, hostile care/sports litigation — below parent despite no criminal penalty or enforcement mechanism.

Among worst divisions: birth-certificate changes effectively banned framed as forcing disclosure, bathroom exclusion authorised in state facilities, sports bans, no hate-crime cover for gender identity, hostile party platform, pending religious-refusal bill.

Most-Protective tier with visitor-facing wins: public-accommodations ban covering hotels/shops, gender-neutral single-occupancy restrooms, self-ID documents with X, shield law, hate-crime cover; only national passport/entry regime caps it below 0.75.
